messages:
sam: hey everyone, first-week question. trying to run a quick smoke test that needs a tiny GCE VM in project redwood-eval-multi (europe-west1) but the project shows billing linked to the wrong billing account (an old sandbox acct). people-ops sent the invite but the link landed on a different billing folder. also when I try to assume the AWS onboarding role I get a 'MalformedPolicyDocument' error. who do I ping to reassign billing to the correct billing account and to check the AWS role policy? :wave:

tara: welcome sam! for billing we sometimes see projects get attached to the sibling "sandbox-archive" billing folder if the invite was accepted from a forwarded link. people-ops can resend and infra can attach the right billing-account. for AWS MalformedPolicyDocument, paste the assume-role command and the AWS CLI error and we'll inspect.

sam: thanks. gcloud i ran: 
```
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-eval-multi --format=json
```
output shows: "billingAccountName": "billingAccounts/0000-ARCHIVE-1111" but people-ops told me it should be billingAccounts/3333-CORP-2222.

aws command: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/Redwood-Onboard-Test --role-session-name sam-local
```
and returned: "An error occurred (MalformedPolicyDocument) when calling the AssumeRole operation: Policy has invalid JSON
"

people-ops: hey Sam  i see the invite was accepted but it looks like the project was created under the "sandbox-archive" folder which inherited that billing link. i'll resend the proper billing invite to your account and DM the target billing-account-id (3333-CORP-2222). if you accept and it's still wrong, infra will manually reattach.

cloud-ops: for the AWS error, common cause is a role trust policy with a stray comma or an ARN with an unexpected character. if you DM the role arn i'll fetch the AssumeRolePolicyDocument and validate JSON. quick debug: try `aws iam get-role --role-name Redwood-Onboard-Test --profile onboarding` if you have perms. if not, share the arn and we'll fetch.

sam: i don't have onboarding perms for get-role, DM'd the role arn to cloud-ops. accepted the people-ops resend (check your spam/promotions).

infra-setup-bot: ticket created: INF-9510. Action items: 1) verify project redwood-eval-multi folder placement and reattach billing-account 3333-CORP-2222 if people-ops confirm acceptance, 2) if project was created under sandbox-archive request manager approval to move or reparent project. ETA 2 hours. For AWS role policy fetch, cloud-ops will report back.

cloud-ops: fetched trust policy for arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/Redwood-Onboard-Test. Found trailing comma in the Principal array which caused the MalformedPolicyDocument error. Opened PR to patch trust policy to: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/OnboardingFacade"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}`. Patching now, will notify when done.

sam: awesome, thanks. accepted the billing invite and double-checked `gcloud beta billing projects describe` now returns billingAccounts/3333-CORP-2222 (still waiting for infra to confirm move).

infra-setup-bot: update INF-9510: billing reattached to 3333-CORP-2222 and project reparented to onboarding folder (manager approval verified). Ticket closed.

cloud-ops: trust policy patched and role assume now succeeds for the onboarding profile. sample successful command output: 
```
$ aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/Redwood-Onboard-Test --role-session-name sam-local --profile onboarding
{
  "Credentials": {
    "AccessKeyId": "ASIA...",
    "SecretAccessKey": "...",
    "SessionToken": "...",
    "Expiration": "2026-05-01T12:34:56Z"
  },
  "AssumedRoleUser": {
    "AssumedRoleId": "AROA...:sam-local",
    "Arn": "arn:aws:sts::888777666555:assumed-role/Redwood-Onboard-Test/sam-local"
  }
}
```

sam: confirmed i can create the tiny VM now: 
```
gcloud compute instances create smoke-test --project=redwood-eval-multi --zone=europe-west1-b --machine-type=e2-micro
```
succeeded. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada: If anyone sees weird billing audit logs for the project reparenting let me know and i'll file a ticket.

tara: welcome aboard Sam! glad it's unblocked. if you need longer-term multi-folder billing or want to run larger quota tests ping infra and we'll file formal requests. :rocket:
